title: PLAYERS IN ACTION: BOUNCY WALK, HIT FLASH, LOW HEALTH, KNEELING DOWNED, FALL TO LIGHT, AIM LINE
why: His picks from the art survey (a11 B, a12 B, a13 D, a14 B, a15 B, a16 B): a bouncier walk and sprint with a little squash and stretch; a hit flashes the whole body white for 66 ms, then red, with a small recoil; at low health the body gets stains and drips and its outline pulses red; a downed player kneels with the gun on the ground inside a pulsing red ring; a player who dies drops flat and breaks into rising points of light; a faint dotted line runs from the gun toward the crosshair, and the two top rarity tiers and the golden gun show a red laser while the sights are held. Drawing only: no random draw and nothing the sim reads.
now: Bodies bounce, flash white then red when hit, show blood and a red outline at low health, kneel when downed, fall into light when dead, and every gun shows a dotted aim line (rare guns a red laser while aiming).
